text: This report recommends that the name "Sunday Mews" be approved to identify the naming of a Public Lane located east of Logan Avenue, west of Morse Street. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name “Sunday Mews” for the naming of a Public Lane located east of Logan Avenue, west of Morse Street.
